description: This file defines structures and functions for managing HNS (Host Networking Service) networks in Windows, including creating, deleting, and querying networks and endpoints.

classes.name: HNSNetwork
classes.description: Represents a network in HNS with properties like ID, Name, Type, Subnets, Policies, etc.

classes.name: Subnet
classes.description: Represents a subnet associated with a network, including address prefix, gateway, and policies.

classes.name: MacPool
classes.description: Represents a range of MAC addresses available to the network.

classes.name: hnsResponse
classes.description: Internal structure for handling responses from HNS API calls.

methods.name: HNSNetworkRequest
methods.description: Makes an API call to HNS to update or query a single network.

methods.name: HNSListNetworkRequest
methods.description: Queries the list of available HNS networks.

methods.name: GetHNSNetworkByID
methods.description: Retrieves an HNS network by its ID.

methods.name: GetHNSNetworkByName
methods.description: Retrieves an HNS network filtered by its name.

methods.name: NewEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new endpoint on the network with specified IP and MAC addresses.

methods.name: CreateEndpoint
methods.description: Creates an endpoint on the network.

methods.name: CreateRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a remote endpoint on the network.
